# Vendor Security Policy

Revision: v02. Effective: 2023-09-16. Owner: Director of IT Operations.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for vendor security. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to all production systems and the data they process. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** This document is reviewed every 12 months and after any incident that invokes it.
- **R2.** Encryption in transit uses current, non-deprecated protocol versions only.
- **R3.** Backups of in-scope systems run at least every 24 hours and are tested quarterly.
- **R4.** Shared accounts are prohibited; every action is attributable to a named individual.
- **R5.** Records covered by this policy are retained for 365 days from the date of their creation and then deleted.
- **R6.** Interactive sessions expire after 12 hours and require re-authentication.
- **R7.** Third parties handling in-scope data are bound by a written agreement that imposes equivalent requirements.
- **R8.** Exceptions to this policy are approved in writing by the document owner and recorded in the exception register.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Director of IT Operations, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
